description: Confirm that a fix worked. Reads the page again right now (never a cached result) and answers, for each problem code you pass, passed, failing or not_measured. Use the codes returned by audit_url or geo_check, after you change the page.

codes.description: Problem codes to check, as returned by audit_url or geo_check (e.g. missing_h1).

lang.description: Language of names and recommendations. Default: en.

url.description: Full public URL of the page, with http:// or https://.

name: verify
title: Verify a fix
